anchors.paper_title: bigP3BCI: An Open, Diverse and Machine Learning Ready P300-based Brain-Computer Interface Dataset
anchors.reason: The candidate paper title and abstract explicitly describe the creation and contents of the 'bigP3BCI' dataset, which matches the dataset's focus on P300-based BCI data.

metadata.methods_description: EEG data were acquired using a g.USBamp amplifier (g.tec) with 16 channels arranged in a standard 10-20 montage, sampled at 256 Hz with a 60 Hz line frequency. The experimental protocol employed a P300 paradigm using a 6x6 character grid speller with visual stimulus presentation. Each trial had a duration of 1.0 second, with events classified as Target or NonTarget stimuli. A calibration-then-test cross-validation approach was used for within-subject evaluation, with online feedback provided during the BCI application.
